description: Update an existing program — only the fields you provide change. Edit its name, description, status, owner, lead, whether it is long-lived, target date, coverage goal, tags, or whether its work items need test evidence before they can be marked Done. Incoming requests are switched with anyforge_set_program_request_intake. Requires `write` scope.

changeFreezes.description: The program's change freezes (a client's Black Friday freeze): the WHOLE list, replacing the stored one; [] removes them all. Drawn as bands on the program's Gantt, they gate nothing, but they move the forecast: a milestone whose work ends inside one is forecast for the day after it. A malformed entry refuses the whole write.

endDate.description: Last frozen day, yyyy-mm-dd, on or after startDate.

id.description: Stable id; omit for a new freeze.

name.description: What the freeze is, e.g. "Black Friday freeze".

longLived.description: true for a standing program that never ends; false makes it bounded.

programLeadUid.description: Program lead uid: must be an approved member of the workspace. An empty string clears the lead.

targetDate.description: Target completion date (ISO yyyy-mm-dd); empty string clears it.

testEvidenceRequired.description: When true, a work item in this program cannot be marked Done until it has at least one test evidence entry (any result); marking one Done without any is refused with 409 test_evidence_required. false turns it off. Items already Done are not affected, and close-as-fixed and a crew finishing its own run are not held by it.

name: anyforge_update_program
title: Update program
